title: Plancherel identity
statement: Let $F$ be a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$, with a full-support probability law and an orthonormal basis containing the constant-one function at a distinguished index. For any complex-valued functions $f,g$ on $Ω$, their probability-weighted inner product equals $\sum_{i\in ι}\overline{\widehat f(i)}\,\widehat g(i)$, where the coefficients are taken in the chosen basis.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$
The probability law of $F$ has full support
The basis of $F$ is orthonormal and includes the constant-one function at its distinguished index
